experiment: OWN-105 runner hardening: bounded reconciliation, unresolved-completion guard, receipt on read failure (kvnloo/cua#105)
registered_utc: see the commit time of the commit that adds this file (before the first measured trial)

sources.measured_tree: the PREREG commit; its libs/cua-driver/examples/jev-use tree equals the fix commit (session-env records worktree_head and a clean jev-use status per block)
sources.driver_source: a0bca744067d04f05904319d3d919be30c336556; git diff --quiet a0bca7440 98a45e6c5 -- libs/cua-driver/rust rc=0

hypothesis: The three R2-05 runner gaps close with minimal caller-side runner code and no new service. G1: an ambiguous action error is resolved by bounded fresh oracle reads (0.1 s interval, 3 s deadline) into verified, refuted or unresolved_unknown, and a first negative read never authorizes another dispatch. G2: no second completion is dispatched while a dispatched completion is unresolved. G3: a read failure after an unverified completion ends with a receipt instead of escaping. Reconsideration happens exactly once and only when the mutation request's own write provably raised (caller-side write ledger on the transport write); an error class alone is not proof.
forced_path: Unmodified jev-use runners at the measured tree (python/run.py run(); typescript/run.ts via its CLI), --provider mock --guarded-completion --visual-observation off --max-steps 4. Step 1 the mock provider types the token; step 2 guarded completion dispatches Submit (browser_click, dom_event). Real MCP stdio, real Driver 0.31.0, real Chrome, private Xvfb.
fixture: R2-05 owned loopback fixture with target journal, page variant with a non-navigating Submit (fetch POST of the same form body; Submit stays observable). Placements for the first submit: immediate, after_unchanged:1, withheld (released by the harness after the runner exits).

rows.R1_ack_lost_applied: ack_lost: Driver answer held until journal applied, dropped, EOF; immediate
rows.R2_delayed_within_deadline: ack_lost with barrier received; effect lands only after one unchanged /state read (after_unchanged:1)
rows.R3_delayed_past_deadline: ack_lost with barrier received; withheld past the runner's deadline
rows.R4_read_failure_after_unverified: Submit answer delivered; withheld; the next semantic snapshot answer is replaced with a tool error result
rows.R5_replanned_completion: no fault; withheld; Submit stays observable so the provider re-plans it at step 3
rows.R6_own_write_raised: pre_dispatch: after the step-2 snapshot answer the caller-side write is closed; the Submit request's own write raises before anything is sent (Python: anyio ClosedResourceError from the session write stream; TypeScript: StdioClientTransport.send raises 'Not connected' before writing); EOF follows
rows.R6n_unproven_not_written: negative control for the pre-write rule: nothing is sent but there is no proof the request's own write raised (Python request_lost: the write returns, the seam drops the request, EOF; TypeScript closed_before_request: EOF right after the snapshot answer, the SDK refuses the request before send())

arms_and_n.py_unfixed: 5 each for R1, R3, R4, R5 (base runner 98a45e6c5)

schedule: deterministic round-robin over (row, arm) cells, rotated per round, odd rounds reversed (run_trials.schedule); blocks of at most 10 trials, each block holds flock -s quiet-lane.lock (shared) for its whole run; every trial kept
oracle: target journal owned by the fixture (received and applied per POST /submit with op number and release reason, every /state read with effect visibility); read by the harness after the runner exits, after releasing held operations and waiting for quiescence. The runner's outcome and receipts are under test, never the oracle.
metrics: computed by verify_artifacts.py from raw/measured only: duplicates = max(0, applied-1); second_dispatches = max(0, received-1); receipt_ok = final outcome event carries mutation_outcome with receiptKind mutation-outcome/v0, resolution in {verified, refuted, unresolved_unknown, pre_write_failed}, keys within the v0 set plus resolution, token absent from the log; landed_as_failure = applied>=1 and (crash or outcome not in {verified, unknown} or final resolution pre_write_failed); restart_while_unresolved = a second session after a Submit reached the Driver in the first; placement checks per fault (fault fired, barrier reached, journal probe applied 0 where the effect must not have landed, first submit not applied before runner exit in R3/R4/R5, a negative post-dispatch read before apply in R2, no Submit forwarded before the R6/R6n fault).

gates.KEEP: for the fixed runners: 0 duplicate mutations across all rows; 100% of trials end with a content-free receipt (verified / refuted / unresolved_unknown / pre_write_failed); 0 landed effects classified as failure; R5 has 0 second dispatches; every R6 trial makes exactly one reconsideration; the unfixed control reproduces >=1 gap; the jev-use suites, typecheck and the 4 CLI verifiers pass at the fix head; and fault placement holds in 100% of placement-checked trials (validity condition added by this lane)
gates.KILL: any blind second effect (duplicate or second dispatch) in a fixed arm, a landed effect reported as failure, or a restart from step 1 while unresolved

predictions_fixed.R2_delayed_within_deadline: verified after a first negative read, phase action
predictions_fixed.R4_read_failure_after_unverified: unknown, unresolved_unknown, phase observe, no crash
predictions_fixed.R5_replanned_completion: unknown, unresolved_unknown, phase completion_blocked, 1 Submit reaches the Driver
predictions_fixed.R6_own_write_raised: one reconsider event (pre_write_failed, attempted false, effect none, retryDisposition reconsider), two sessions, verified

unfixed_gap_predicates.R1_ack_lost_applied: G1: outcome unknown, receipt without resolution, effect applied at runner exit, 0 post-dispatch oracle reads before exit
unfixed_gap_predicates.R3_delayed_past_deadline: G1: outcome unknown, receipt without resolution, 0 post-dispatch oracle reads before exit
unfixed_gap_predicates.R4_read_failure_after_unverified: G3: the runner raised (no outcome event, no receipt)
unfixed_gap_predicates.R5_replanned_completion: G2: journal received >= 2 at runner exit

pilots: Plumbing pilots before registration, excluded from all denominators and kept in raw/pilot/: pilot1 (10 trials; 2 TypeScript trials failed to start because the entry was compiled as CommonJS, fixed by renaming it to .mts) and pilot2 (12 trials).
